boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct study environments in Southwestern’s A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center, from quiet alcoves to collaborative commons.

cards.title: Academic Commons
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Set up here when working near library services makes sense; the library identifies it as a first-floor, noisy high-traffic study area.
cards.short_summary: A central first-floor work area with an active library atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern lists Academic Commons among the first-floor noisy, high-traffic spaces in Smith Library Center.
cards.access_notes: Located in the library’s first-floor study area; follow current library access policies and hours.

cards.title: The Courtyard
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Bring a reading task or laptop and use this first-floor quiet area; choose it when you want a library setting away from high-traffic zones.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet first-floor study setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern identifies The Courtyard as a quiet space on the first floor of Smith Library Center.
cards.access_notes: Quiet space in Smith Library Center; access is subject to current library policies and hours.

cards.title: Periodicals Reading Room
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Use the reading-room setting for research materials or individual work; the library classifies it as a first-floor high-traffic space.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor reading room within the library’s active study zone.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern lists the Periodicals Reading Room as a first-floor noisy, high-traffic space in Smith Library Center.
cards.access_notes: The CD listening station in this room is available when the library is open; general space access follows library policies.

cards.title: Prothro Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Take a book or laptop to this second-floor room when it is available; Southwestern notes there are no tables, so plan accordingly.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, table-free second-floor room for flexible individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern lists the Prothro Room as a quiet second-floor space and says students may study there when it is not in use.
cards.access_notes: No tables; use only when the room is not in use. Follow current library access policies and hours.

cards.title: SLC 202/204 Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Second floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Choose this second-floor computer lab when a library workstation fits the task; expect a busier setting rather than a silent room.
cards.short_summary: A computer-equipped second-floor environment for digital coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern lists the Computer Lab in SLC 202/204 among Smith Library Center’s noisy, high-traffic second-floor spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in rooms SLC 202/204; follow current library computer-use and building-access policies.

cards.title: Women’s Studies Alcove
cards.subtitle: Third floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Work beside the curated Women’s Studies collection on the third floor, using the alcove as a focused study-and-reflection setting.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor alcove furnished around a Women’s Studies collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern says the Women’s Studies Alcove is a third-floor study and reflection space with works by and about women.
cards.access_notes: Third-floor library alcove; access is subject to current Smith Library Center policies and hours.

cards.title: Dobie Alcove
cards.subtitle: Third floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Settle in with course reading beside works about J. Frank and Bertha Dobie; this alcove is on the library’s third floor.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor study alcove centered on the Dobies’ literary legacy.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern identifies the Dobie Alcove as a third-floor space with works by and about J. Frank and Bertha Dobie.
cards.access_notes: Third-floor library alcove; access is subject to current Smith Library Center policies and hours.

cards.title: Enduring Legacies Alcove
cards.subtitle: Third floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Use this third-floor alcove for quiet reading near materials that showcase Special Collections donors and their gifts to the university.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor alcove connecting study time with Special Collections context.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern describes the Enduring Legacies Alcove as a third-floor study space showcasing donors and their gifts to Special Collections.
cards.access_notes: Third-floor library alcove; access is subject to current Smith Library Center policies and hours.

cards.title: Melville Alcove
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Bring a reading-heavy assignment to this first-floor alcove, whose surrounding collection focuses on Herman Melville and his contemporaries.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor alcove framed by a Herman Melville-focused collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern says the Melville Alcove is on the first floor and includes works by and about Herman Melville and his contemporaries.
cards.access_notes: First-floor library alcove; access is subject to current Smith Library Center policies and hours.

cards.title: Lynne Brody/Writer’s Voice Alcove
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Draft or read in this first-floor alcove, where the collection highlights published monographs and novels by Southwestern faculty authors.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor alcove with a collection celebrating Southwestern faculty authors.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern identifies the Lynne Brody/Writer’s Voice Alcove as a first-floor space featuring published monographs and novels by Southwestern faculty authors.
cards.access_notes: First-floor library alcove; access is subject to current Smith Library Center policies and hours.
